Initial release of guaikei抖音档案调取:

- Enables Douyin (TikTok China) public data access: keyword search, creator posts, video comments, and real-time hot topic queries.
- Provides detailed intent recognition and parameter mapping for user queries in Chinese.
- Enforces strict token management: neutral errors, no contact or promotional output when tokens are invalid.
- Outputs pure JSON results, with standard error handling and clear command-line usage.
- Does not support publishing, editing, or downloading of videos.
